job.job_description:
Job Profile: MENDIX ENGINEER

DESCRIPTION OF THE ROLE:
We are not looking for someone who simply develops Mendix applications.
We are looking for a Mendix Engineer who believes Artificial Intelligence is changing software engineering and wants to be part of that transformation.
The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Mendix application development while actively leveraging AI technologies to build next-generation enterprise solutions.
More importantly, we want someone who continuously learns new technologies, embraces challenges, and can quickly switch between platforms whenever business demands change.

Key Deliverables

Mendix Development


Design scalable enterprise applications using Mendix.
Build complex Domain Models.
Develop reusable Microflows and Nanoflows.
Design reusable Marketplace Components.
Implement Security, Roles and Access Management.
Optimize application performance.
Build responsive web and mobile applications.
Develop maintainable and reusable modules.

AI & Agentic Engineering


Design and build enterprise applications powered by Artificial Intelligence.
Develop Agentic AI solutions capable of autonomous reasoning, planning and task execution.
Build conversational AI assistants inside enterprise applications.
Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs) into Mendix applications.
Design AI-powered business workflows that reduce manual effort.
Evaluate and rapidly adopt emerging AI technologies.


Qualifications & Work Experience
Mandatory Technical Skills
Mendix


Minimum 3 5 years of hands-on Mendix development experience.
Strong understanding of Domain Models.
Expert in Microflows.
Strong experience in Nanoflows.
Java Actions.
XPath.
Security.
Offline-first Applications.
Scheduled Events.
Task Queues.
Widgets.
Marketplace Modules.
Performance Optimization.
Deployment Pipelines.


Artificial Intelligence
Hands-on experience in:


Generative AI
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt Engineering
AI API Integration
Agentic AI
AI Agents
MCP (Model Context Protocol)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
AI Orchestration
AI-assisted Development

Experience with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI or equivalent AI platforms will be highly preferred.

Preferred Skills

Personal Abilities / Skills
We believe attitude outweighs technology.
The ideal candidate should demonstrate:


AI-first mindsetnaturally thinks about solving problems using Artificial Intelligence before traditional approaches.
Strong technical foundation with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent hands-on expertise in Mendix, especially Microflows, Nanoflows, integrations, security, and enterprise architecture.
Passion for Agentic AI and next-generation software engineering.
Ability to accept challenges and grow exponentially.
Ability to quickly learn any new technology required by the business.
Comfortable switching between Mendix, AI, cloud platforms, integrations, and enterprise technologies.
Strong ownership and accountability.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and spoken).
Curiosity to continuously experiment with emerging technologies.
Self-motivated with a startup mindset inside an enterprise organization.


What Will Make You Stand Out
We are looking for engineers who are excited about the future of software development.
Someone who spends time exploring new AI tools before they become mainstream.
Someone who enjoys building AI agents over repetitive workflows.
We hire engineers for their ability to learn, innovate, and adaptnot just for the technologies they already know.
